mapper.sql: select a.id, a.group_no, a.protocol, a.host, a.port, a.username, a.password, a.proxy_url, a.max_bindable, a.current_bind_count, a.history_bind_count, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, b.title as groupTitle from tg_proxy_ip a left join tg_proxy_group b on a.group_no = b.group_no
mapper.insert: insert into tg_proxy_ip (group_no, protocol, host, port, username, password, proxy_url, max_bindable) values (#{groupNo}, #{protocol}, #{host}, #{port}, #{username}, #{password}, #{proxyUrl}, #{maxBindable})

insert into tg_proxy_ip (group_no, protocol, host, port, username, password, proxy_url, max_bindable) values
(#{item.groupNo}, #{item.protocol}, #{item.host}, #{item.port}, #{item.username}, #{item.password}, #{item.proxyUrl}, #{item.maxBindable})
mapper.delete:
delete from tg_proxy_ip where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: where a.group_no = #{groupNo} AND a.status = 'active' AND (a.current_bind_count IS NULL OR a.current_bind_count < a.max_bindable) order by a.current_bind_count asc
mapper.update: update tg_proxy_ip set current_bind_count = COALESCE(current_bind_count, 0) + 1, history_bind_count = COALESCE(history_bind_count, 0) + 1 where id = #{id}
update tg_proxy_ip set current_bind_count = current_bind_count - 1 where id = #{id} AND current_bind_count > 0

update tg_proxy_ip p set p.current_bind_count = ( select count(*) from tg_telethon_account a where a.proxy_ip_id = p.id AND (a.is_deleted IS NULL OR a.is_deleted = 0) )
p.group_no = #{groupNo}
